No automatic metrics were used to evaluate generated outputs - evaluation was based on accuracy for classification tasks and human evaluation for summarization.
LLMs (GPT-4 and Llama2-70B) were used as generators, not as judges/evaluators of outputs.

guideline: Summary sentences linked to respective sentence edits via ea linkages
Factuality measured by percentage of summary sentences accurately referring to actual edits
Comprehensiveness measured by extent of edits encapsulated in summary
Specificity measured by proportion of concrete summary sentences
Compactness measured by average number of edits per summary sentence
Organization measured by logical arrangement of summary content

overall_notes: The paper primarily focuses on NLG evaluation through classification tasks (edit intent classification, revision alignment, review request extraction) and one generation task (document edit summarization). Evaluation methods include accuracy metrics for classification tasks and human evaluation for summarization task. No automatic NLG metrics or LLM-as-judge approaches were used.
